package handler

// Explicit disposable restored-MySQL/service validation, not authenticated HTTP.
import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"crypto/sha256"
	"database/sql"
	"encoding/hex"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"os/exec"
	"path/filepath"
	"regexp"
	"strings"
	"sync"
	"testing"
	"time"

	driver "github.com/go-sql-driver/mysql"
	"github.com/google/uuid"
	"github.com/talent-assessment/refactored/internal/model"
	"github.com/talent-assessment/refactored/internal/service"
	"github.com/talent-assessment/refactored/pkg/libreofficepdf"
	"gorm.io/driver/mysql"
	"gorm.io/gorm"
	"gorm.io/gorm/logger"
)

// The production constructor preserves Logger across its private registry.
// No SQL arguments, interpolated values or raw errors are logged or retained.
type mngLifecycleTrace struct {
	logger.Interface
	mu sync.Mutex
	observe func(context.Context, string, int64, error)
}

func (l *mngLifecycleTrace) ParamsFilter(ctx context.Context, query string, args ...interface{}) (string, []interface{}) {
	return query, nil
}

func (l *mngLifecycleTrace) Trace(ctx context.Context, begin time.Time, fc func() (string, int64), err error) {
	l.mu.Lock()
	defer l.mu.Unlock()
	if l.observe != nil {
		query, rows := fc()
		l.observe(ctx, query, rows, err)
	}
}

func (l *mngLifecycleTrace) watch(f func(context.Context, string, int64, error)) func() {
	l.mu.Lock(); l.observe = f; l.mu.Unlock()
	return func() { l.mu.Lock(); l.observe = nil; l.mu.Unlock() }
}

func TestManagementTraitsLifecycleRestoredStaging(t *testing.T) {
	dsn, schema, output := os.Getenv("MNG_LIFECYCLE_DSN"), os.Getenv("MNG_LIFECYCLE_SCHEMA"), os.Getenv("MNG_LIFECYCLE_OUTPUT")
	if dsn == "" { t.Skip("explicit owned restored staging database absent") }
	dc, err := driver.ParseDSN(dsn)
	if err != nil || !regexp.MustCompile(`^mng_lifecycle_test_[a-f0-9]{16}$`).MatchString(schema) || dc.DBName != schema || dc.MultiStatements || dc.InterpolateParams || os.Getenv("REPORT_EFFECTIVE_ENV") != "staging" || !filepath.IsAbs(output) { t.Fatal("isolated ownership rejected") }
	trace := &mngLifecycleTrace{Interface: logger.Default.LogMode(logger.Silent)}
	db, err := gorm.Open(mysql.Open(dsn), &gorm.Config{Logger: trace})
	if err != nil { t.Fatal("restored database unavailable") }
	pool, err := db.DB(); if err != nil { t.Fatal("pool") }; defer pool.Close()
	pool.SetMaxOpenConns(4); pool.SetMaxIdleConns(4)
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 210*time.Second); defer cancel()
	began:=time.Now()
	classify:=func(e error) string { if e==nil{return "none"};if errors.Is(e,context.DeadlineExceeded){return "context_deadline"};if errors.Is(e,context.Canceled){return "context_canceled"};if errors.Is(e,service.ErrManagementTraitsRuntimeExpired){return "runtime_expired"};if errors.Is(e,service.ErrManagementTraitsRuntimeToken){return "runtime_token"};if errors.Is(e,service.ErrManagementTraitsRuntimeInvalid){return "runtime_invalid"};var me *driver.MySQLError;if errors.As(e,&me){return fmt.Sprintf("mysql_%d",me.Number)};return "unknown" }
	must := func(e error, stage string) { t.Helper(); if e != nil { t.Logf("FAILURE_STAGE=%s CLASS=%s CONTEXT=%s ELAPSED_MS=%d",stage,classify(e),classify(ctx.Err()),time.Since(began).Milliseconds());t.Fatal("bounded integration failed; raw error withheld") } }
	var actual string; must(db.Raw("SELECT DATABASE()").Scan(&actual).Error,"database"); if actual != schema { t.Fatal("wrong database") }
	var account string;must(db.Raw("SELECT SUBSTRING_INDEX(CURRENT_USER(),'@',1)").Scan(&account).Error,"actual application identity");if account!="positive_app"{t.Fatal("root not accepted as application")};t.Log("ACTUAL_DATABASE_ACCOUNT=positive_app RESTORE_ONLY=1")
	var cross int64; must(db.Raw("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM information_schema.key_column_usage WHERE table_schema=DATABASE() AND referenced_table_schema IS NOT NULL AND referenced_table_schema<>DATABASE()").Scan(&cross).Error,"cross-schema"); if cross != 0 { t.Fatal("cross-schema FK") }
	secret := os.Getenv("JWT_SECRET"); if secret == "" { t.Fatal("actual configuration secret absent") }
	svc := service.NewManagementTraitsRuntimeService(db,secret,8<<20)
	must(svc.CheckRuntimeSchema(ctx),"fresh production schema")
	if os.Getenv("MNG_LIFECYCLE_WORKER_CHILD")=="1" {
		paper:=os.Getenv("MNG_LIFECYCLE_WORKER_PAPER");if _,e:=uuid.Parse(paper);e!=nil{t.Fatal("worker owned paper")}
		var owner int64;must(db.Table("el_mng_paper_snapshot").Where("paper_id = ? AND source = ?",paper,"new_creation").Count(&owner).Error,"worker ownership");if owner!=1{t.Fatal("worker ownership count")}
		wc,stop:=context.WithCancel(ctx);defer stop();done:=make(chan struct{});errs:=make(chan error,1)
		scanSeen:=make(chan struct{});var scanOnce sync.Once
		removeScan:=trace.watch(func(c context.Context,query string,rows int64,e error){if c==wc&&e==nil&&strings.HasPrefix(query,"SELECT s.paper_id, s.exam_id,"){scanOnce.Do(func(){close(scanSeen)})}})
		defer removeScan()
		go func(){defer close(done);svc.RunExpiry(wc,time.Hour,100,func(e error){select{case errs<-e:default:}})}()
		defer func(){stop();<-done}()
		select{case <-scanSeen:case <-ctx.Done():must(ctx.Err(),"worker real startup scan")}
		if os.Getenv("MNG_LIFECYCLE_WORKER_EXPECT")=="pending" {
			// Explicit synchronous scan is evidence of the first process reading the unexpired DB.
			must(svc.ScanExpiry(ctx,100),"first worker unexpired scan")
			var n int64;must(db.Table("el_mng_result_run").Where("paper_id = ?",paper).Count(&n).Error,"offline pre-count");if n!=0{t.Fatal("unexpired worker submitted")}
			must(os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(output,"worker-ready"),[]byte("UNEXPIRED_SCAN_PASS"),0600),"worker ready")
			<-wc.Done();return
		}
		watch,stopWatch:=context.WithTimeout(ctx,15*time.Second);defer stopWatch();ticker:=time.NewTicker(100*time.Millisecond);defer ticker.Stop()
		for {var n,remaining int64;must(db.WithContext(watch).Table("el_mng_result_run").Where("paper_id = ?",paper).Count(&n).Error,"worker result observation");must(db.WithContext(watch).Raw("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM el_mng_paper_snapshot s INNER JOIN el_paper p ON p.id=s.paper_id WHERE s.source=? AND p.state=1 AND s.limit_time<=?","new_creation",time.Now()).Scan(&remaining).Error,"worker entire sweep observation");if n==1&&remaining==0{t.Logf("RESTORED_WORKER_RESTART_IMMEDIATE_MS=%d ACTUAL_RUNEXPIRY_SCAN=1 ALL_EXPIRED_SETTLED=1 MAIN_SYSTEMD_RESTART=0",time.Since(began).Milliseconds());return};select{case e:=<-errs:must(e,"worker error");case <-watch.Done():must(watch.Err(),"worker startup deadline");case <-ticker.C:}}
	}
	for _, table := range []string{"el_mng_exam_profile","el_mng_paper_snapshot","el_mng_result_run","el_mng_report_revision"} { var n int64; must(db.Table(table).Count(&n).Error,"empty"); if n != 0 { t.Fatal("restore not empty") } }
	rawContent, err := os.ReadFile(os.Getenv("MNG_TEST_CONTENT_PATH")); must(err,"content")
	content, err := service.LoadManagementTraitsTestContent(rawContent); must(err,"205 content")
	template, err := os.ReadFile(os.Getenv("MNG_TEST_TEMPLATE_PATH")); must(err,"template")
	sha := func(b []byte) string { h:=sha256.Sum256(b); return hex.EncodeToString(h[:]) }
	if sha(template) != "05c55e77e567c6111ba62c08f2e69b4d5e5b416b2dd989c49914cc95b962a84c" { t.Fatal("template SHA") }
	must(os.MkdirAll(output,0700),"output")
	type owned struct { exam string; profile model.ManagementTraitsExamProfile; participant service.ManagementTraitsRuntimeClaims; paper service.ManagementTraitsRuntimePaperDetail; claims service.ManagementTraitsRuntimeClaims }
	parse := func(token,purpose string) service.ManagementTraitsRuntimeClaims { c,e:=service.ParseManagementTraitsRuntimeToken(secret,token,purpose,time.Now()); must(e,"server-issued credential"); return c }
	candidateName:="MTL synthetic"
	create := func(code,kind string) owned {
		var repo model.Repo; must(db.Where("code = ?",code).Take(&repo).Error,"source")
		id:=uuid.NewString(); open:=1; if kind=="tester" { open=2 }
		exam:=model.Exam{ID:id,Title:"MTL"+id[:8],AssessmentType:"legacy",ScoringMode:"legacy",TotalTime:25,RequiredFields:"name",IsOpen:open,JoinType:1}
		must(db.Create(&exam).Error,"owned exam"); must(db.Create(&model.ExamRepo{ID:uuid.NewString(),ExamID:id,RepoID:repo.ID,RadioCount:140}).Error,"owned link")
		var identity service.ManagementTraitsIdentityResponse
		if kind=="tester" {
			pid,pwd,status,del:=uuid.NewString(),uuid.NewString(),"0",0
			must(db.Create(&model.Tester{ID:pid,ExamID:&id,IDNumber:"MTL"+id[:8],Name:"MTL synthetic",Password:pwd,Status:&status,DelFlag:&del}).Error,"own tester")
			profile,e:=svc.FreezeProfile(ctx,id); must(e,"freeze tester")
			r,handled,e:=svc.TryTesterIdentity(ctx,id,pid,pwd); must(e,"normal tester identity"); if !handled { t.Fatal("tester fallback") }; identity=r
			c:=parse(identity.ParticipantToken,service.ManagementTraitsRuntimeParticipantPurpose); p,e:=svc.CreatePaper(ctx,c); must(e,"create tester"); return owned{id,profile,c,p,parse(p.PaperToken,service.ManagementTraitsRuntimePaperPurpose)}
		}
		profile,e:=svc.FreezeProfile(ctx,id); must(e,"freeze candidate")
		r,handled,e:=svc.TryRegisterCandidateIdentity(ctx,service.ManagementTraitsCandidateIdentityRequest{ExamID:id,Name:candidateName},""); must(e,"candidate identity"); if !handled { t.Fatal("candidate fallback") }; identity=r
		c:=parse(identity.ParticipantToken,service.ManagementTraitsRuntimeParticipantPurpose); p,e:=svc.CreatePaper(ctx,c); must(e,"create candidate")
		if len(p.Questions)!=140 || !p.Deadline.Equal(p.StartedAt.Add(25*time.Minute)) { t.Fatal("140/25 frozen contract") }
		return owned{id,profile,c,p,parse(p.PaperToken,service.ManagementTraitsRuntimePaperPurpose)}
	}
	fill := func(o owned,n,mode int) {
		phase:=time.Now()
		var rows []model.ManagementTraitsPaperQuestionSnapshot; must(db.Where("paper_id = ?",o.paper.PaperID).Order("v_number").Find(&rows).Error,"read frozen questions")
		if len(rows)!=140 { t.Fatal("snapshot count") }
		for i,q:=range rows { if i>=n { break }; final:=mode; if mode==0 { final=1+q.Number%5 }; raw:=final; if q.Reverse { raw=6-final }
			var options []service.ManagementTraitsMappedOption; must(json.Unmarshal([]byte(q.OptionsSnapshot),&options),"frozen options")
			option:=""; for _,v:=range options { if v.Raw==raw { option=v.SourceOptionID } }; if option=="" { t.Fatal("option raw") }
			_,e:=svc.FillAnswer(ctx,o.claims,q.PaperQuestionID,option); must(e,"actual save")
		}
		var nread int64; must(db.Model(&model.ManagementTraitsPaperQuestionSnapshot{}).Where("paper_id = ? AND raw_answer IS NOT NULL",o.paper.PaperID).Count(&nread).Error,"save readback"); if nread!=int64(n) { t.Fatal("save cardinality") }
		t.Logf("PHASE=fill ANSWERED=%d ELAPSED_MS=%d CONTEXT=%s",n,time.Since(phase).Milliseconds(),classify(ctx.Err()))
	}
	// Only this disposable schema's exact PKs are adjusted. The 25-minute source,
	// profile, evidence hash, snapshot, paper and question timestamps stay coherent.
	window := func(o owned, offset time.Duration) {
		captured:=time.Now().Add(offset-26*time.Minute).Truncate(time.Second); started:=captured.Add(time.Minute); deadline:=started.Add(25*time.Minute)
		must(db.Transaction(func(tx *gorm.DB) error {
			var p model.ManagementTraitsExamProfile; if e:=tx.Where("exam_id = ?",o.exam).Take(&p).Error;e!=nil{return e}
			var s model.ManagementTraitsPaperSnapshot; if e:=tx.Where("paper_id = ?",o.paper.PaperID).Take(&s).Error;e!=nil{return e}
			var fields map[string]any; if e:=json.Unmarshal([]byte(p.FieldContract),&fields);e!=nil{return e}; fields["capturedAt"]=captured.Format(time.RFC3339Nano); f,e:=json.Marshal(fields);if e!=nil{return e}
			var evidence map[string]any;if e:=json.Unmarshal([]byte(s.EvidenceSnapshot),&evidence);e!=nil{return e};evidence["capturedAt"]=captured.Format(time.RFC3339Nano)
			// Production evidence hash uses a fixed struct order, not map JSON order.
			ev:=struct { Schema string `json:"schema"`; Source string `json:"source"`; RepoCode string `json:"repoCode"`; CapturedAt time.Time `json:"capturedAt"`; ManifestSHA string `json:"manifestSha"`; MappingSHA string `json:"mappingSha"` }{fmt.Sprint(evidence["schema"]),fmt.Sprint(evidence["source"]),fmt.Sprint(evidence["repoCode"]),captured,fmt.Sprint(evidence["manifestSha"]),fmt.Sprint(evidence["mappingSha"])}
			b,e:=json.Marshal(ev);if e!=nil{return e}
			for _,u:=range []struct{table,key,id string; values map[string]any}{
				{"el_mng_exam_profile","exam_id",o.exam,map[string]any{"frozen_at":captured,"created_at":captured,"field_contract":string(f)}},
				{"el_mng_paper_snapshot","paper_id",o.paper.PaperID,map[string]any{"source_captured_at":captured,"started_at":started,"created_at":started,"limit_time":deadline,"field_contract":string(f),"evidence_snapshot":string(b),"evidence_sha":sha(b)}},
				{"el_paper","id",o.paper.PaperID,map[string]any{"create_time":started,"limit_time":deadline}},
			} { if e:=tx.Table(u.table).Where(u.key+" = ?",u.id).Updates(u.values).Error;e!=nil{return e} }
			var qs []model.ManagementTraitsPaperQuestionSnapshot;if e:=tx.Where("paper_id = ?",o.paper.PaperID).Find(&qs).Error;e!=nil{return e};for _,q:=range qs { if e:=tx.Model(&model.ManagementTraitsPaperQuestionSnapshot{}).Where("id = ?",q.ID).Update("created_at",started).Error;e!=nil{return e} };return nil
		}),"owned consistent expiry fixture")
	}
	expire := func(o owned) {
		window(o,-time.Minute)
		_,e:=svc.PaperDetail(ctx,o.claims);must(e,"expired metadata accepted")
		_,e=svc.FillAnswer(ctx,o.claims,o.paper.Questions[0].ID,o.paper.Questions[0].Options[0].ID);if !errors.Is(e,service.ErrManagementTraitsRuntimeExpired) { t.Fatal("expired save not rejected") }
	}
	assertRun := func(o owned,r service.ManagementTraitsRuntimeSubmission,n int,complete bool) model.ManagementTraitsResultRun {
		if r.Answered!=n || r.Complete!=complete || r.RunID=="" { t.Fatal("submission summary") }
		var run model.ManagementTraitsResultRun;must(db.Where("id = ?",r.RunID).Take(&run).Error,"run readback")
		for _,a:=range []struct{table,key,value string; expected int64}{{"el_mng_result_run","paper_id",o.paper.PaperID,1},{"el_mng_result_dimension","run_id",r.RunID,13},{"el_mng_result_module","run_id",r.RunID,4},{"el_mng_runtime_receipt","run_id",r.RunID,1}} { var count int64;must(db.Table(a.table).Where(a.key+" = ?",a.value).Count(&count).Error,"result count");if count!=a.expected {t.Fatal("1/13/4/1 invariant")} }
		if !complete { var nd,nm int64;must(db.Table("el_mng_result_dimension").Where("run_id = ? AND (score IS NOT NULL OR norm IS NOT NULL OR level IS NOT NULL)",r.RunID).Count(&nd).Error,"NULL dims");must(db.Table("el_mng_result_module").Where("run_id = ? AND score IS NOT NULL",r.RunID).Count(&nm).Error,"NULL modules");if run.OverallScore!=nil||run.OverallNorm!=nil||run.OverallLevel!=nil||nd!=0||nm!=0 {t.Fatal("incomplete official scores not NULL")}
			called:=false;_,e:=svc.GenerateTestReport(ctx,r.RunID,1,filepath.Join(output,"private"),content,func(context.Context,service.ManagementTraitsTestReportData)([]byte,error){called=true;return nil,nil});if e==nil||called{t.Fatal("incomplete rendered report")}
		}
		_,e:=svc.LoadValidatedRun(ctx,r.RunID);must(e,"actual validated stored run")
		return run
	}
	if os.Getenv("MNG_LIFECYCLE_SCOPE")=="remaining" || os.Getenv("MNG_LIFECYCLE_SCOPE")=="worker-atomic" {
		// No four-report replay: the failing historical slice remains unchanged on disk.
		p2,e:=gorm.Open(mysql.Open(dsn),&gorm.Config{Logger:logger.Default.LogMode(logger.Silent)});must(e,"independent pool");pool2,e:=p2.DB();must(e,"independent pool handle");defer pool2.Close();pool2.SetMaxOpenConns(2);pool2.SetMaxIdleConns(2)
		svc2:=service.NewManagementTraitsRuntimeService(p2,secret,8<<20);must(svc2.CheckRuntimeSchema(ctx),"second fresh schema")
		count:=func(table,key,value string) int64 {var n int64;must(db.Table(table).Where(key+" = ?",value).Count(&n).Error,"exact count");return n}
		negative:=func(e error,stage string){if e==nil{t.Fatal("negative action accepted")};t.Logf("NEGATIVE_STAGE=%s CLASS=%s CONTEXT=%s",stage,classify(e),classify(ctx.Err()))}
		if os.Getenv("MNG_LIFECYCLE_SCOPE")=="remaining" {
		full:=create("00201","candidate");fill(full,140,3);expire(full)
		results:=make([]service.ManagementTraitsRuntimeSubmission,2);errs:=make([]error,2);var wg sync.WaitGroup;start:=make(chan struct{})
		for j:=0;j<2;j++{wg.Add(1);go func(j int){defer wg.Done();<-start;if j==0{results[j],errs[j]=svc.SubmitParticipant(ctx,full.claims,"manual")}else{results[j],errs[j]=svc2.Submit(ctx,full.claims,"manual")}}(j)};close(start);wg.Wait();must(errs[0],"deadline manual");must(errs[1],"deadline trusted worker submit");if results[0].RunID!=results[1].RunID||results[0].Reused==results[1].Reused{t.Fatal("deadline race duplicate")}
		run:=assertRun(full,results[0],140,true);if run.OverallScore==nil||run.OverallScore.String()!="50"{t.Fatal("independent raw3 score50")}
		var receipt model.ManagementTraitsRuntimeReceipt;must(db.Where("run_id = ?",run.ID).Take(&receipt).Error,"deadline receipt");if receipt.SubmitType!="timeout"||receipt.UserTimeSeconds<1500{t.Fatal("deadline receipt time")}
		t.Log("CASE=deadline_full_manual_worker PASS=1 ANSWERS=140 CREATED=1 REUSED=1 RUN=1 DIM=13 MODULE=4 RECEIPT=1 SCORE=50 INDEPENDENT_POOLS=2")
		for _,n:=range []int{0,3}{o:=create("00202","candidate");fill(o,n,3);expire(o);r,e:=svc.SubmitParticipant(ctx,o.claims,"manual");must(e,"incomplete timeout");assertRun(o,r,n,false);var rr model.ManagementTraitsRuntimeReceipt;must(db.Where("run_id = ?",r.RunID).Take(&rr).Error,"incomplete receipt");if rr.SubmitType!="timeout"{t.Fatal("incomplete receipt type")};before:=count("el_mng_paper_question_snapshot","paper_id",o.paper.PaperID);_,e=svc.FillAnswer(ctx,o.claims,o.paper.Questions[0].ID,o.paper.Questions[0].Options[0].ID);negative(e,"expired completed fill");if count("el_mng_paper_question_snapshot","paper_id",o.paper.PaperID)!=before{t.Fatal("expired wrote row")};t.Logf("CASE=incomplete_%d PASS=1 OFFICIAL_NULL=1 REPORT_RENDER_CALLS=0",n)}
		o:=create("00201","candidate");fill(o,1,3);resume,e:=svc.IssueCandidateResume(ctx,o.exam,o.claims.ParticipantID,o.paper.PaperID);must(e,"resume actual service")
		rc:=parse(resume.ParticipantToken,service.ManagementTraitsRuntimePaperPurpose);if rc.ExpiresAt-time.Now().Unix()>300||rc.PaperID!=o.paper.PaperID||rc.ParticipantID!=o.claims.ParticipantID||rc.ExamID!=o.exam{t.Fatal("resume binding TTL")}
		_,e=service.ParseManagementTraitsRuntimeToken(secret,resume.ParticipantToken,service.ManagementTraitsRuntimeParticipantPurpose,time.Now());negative(e,"resume wrong purpose")
		_,e=service.ParseManagementTraitsRuntimeToken(secret,resume.ParticipantToken,service.ManagementTraitsRuntimePaperPurpose,time.Unix(rc.ExpiresAt+1,0));negative(e,"resume parser expiry actual signed credential")
		foreign:=rc;foreign.PaperID=full.paper.PaperID;_,e=svc.PaperDetail(ctx,foreign);negative(e,"resume cross paper")
		_,e=svc.IssueCandidateResume(ctx,o.exam,uuid.NewString(),o.paper.PaperID);negative(e,"resume cross candidate")
		_,e=svc.IssueCandidateResume(ctx,full.exam,o.claims.ParticipantID,o.paper.PaperID);negative(e,"resume cross exam")
		detail,e:=svc.PaperDetail(ctx,rc);must(e,"resume read");if !detail.Deadline.Equal(o.paper.Deadline){t.Fatal("resume reset deadline")}
		t.Log("CASE=secure_resume PASS=1 TTL_MAX=300 HTTP_ADMIN_PROOF=0 NATURAL_5MIN_EXPIRY=UNVERIFIED PARSER_EXPIRY_PASS=1")
		end:=time.Now().Add(-time.Minute);must(db.Model(&model.Exam{}).Where("id = ?",o.exam).Update("end_time",end).Error,"owned exam end")
		existing,e:=svc.CreatePaper(ctx,o.participant);must(e,"existing after exam end");if existing.PaperID!=o.paper.PaperID||!existing.Deadline.Equal(o.paper.Deadline){t.Fatal("exam end reset")}
		_,handled,e:=svc.TryRegisterCandidateIdentity(ctx,service.ManagementTraitsCandidateIdentityRequest{ExamID:o.exam,Name:"MTL after end"},"");negative(e,"end new admission");if !handled{t.Fatal("end legacy fallback")}
		must(db.Model(&model.Exam{}).Where("id = ?",o.exam).Update("end_time",nil).Error,"owned end restore");t.Log("CASE=exam_end PASS=1 EXISTING_DEADLINE_UNCHANGED=1")
		pending,handled,e:=svc.TryRegisterCandidateIdentity(ctx,service.ManagementTraitsCandidateIdentityRequest{ExamID:o.exam,Name:"MTL pending"},"");must(e,"pending identity");if !handled{t.Fatal("pending fallback")};pc:=parse(pending.ParticipantToken,service.ManagementTraitsRuntimeParticipantPurpose)
		var refs int64;must(db.Model(&model.ManagementTraitsExamProfile{}).Where("bundle_id = ?",o.profile.BundleID).Count(&refs).Error,"owned bundle refs");if refs!=2{t.Fatal("unexpected owned bundle refs")}
		must(db.Model(&model.ManagementTraitsDefinitionBundle{}).Where("id = ?",o.profile.BundleID).Update("status","retired").Error,"owned retired")
		_,e=svc.FillAnswer(ctx,o.claims,o.paper.Questions[1].ID,o.paper.Questions[1].Options[0].ID);must(e,"retired existing fill");existing,e=svc.CreatePaper(ctx,o.participant);must(e,"retired existing create");if !existing.Deadline.Equal(o.paper.Deadline){t.Fatal("retired deadline")}
		_,e=svc.CreatePaper(ctx,pc);negative(e,"retired new create");t.Log("CASE=retired PASS=1 FROZEN_CONTINUES=1 NEW_REJECTED=1")
		must(db.Model(&model.ManagementTraitsDefinitionBundle{}).Where("id = ?",o.profile.BundleID).Update("status","revoked").Error,"owned revoked")
		var answersBefore int64;must(db.Model(&model.ManagementTraitsPaperQuestionSnapshot{}).Where("paper_id = ? AND raw_answer IS NOT NULL",o.paper.PaperID).Count(&answersBefore).Error,"revoked before")
		_,e=svc.FillAnswer(ctx,o.claims,o.paper.Questions[2].ID,o.paper.Questions[2].Options[0].ID);negative(e,"revoked fill");_,e=svc.IssueCandidateResume(ctx,o.exam,o.claims.ParticipantID,o.paper.PaperID);negative(e,"revoked resume")
		called:=false;_,e=svc.GenerateTestReport(ctx,run.ID,1,filepath.Join(output,"private"),content,func(context.Context,service.ManagementTraitsTestReportData)([]byte,error){called=true;return nil,nil});negative(e,"revoked report");if called||count("el_mng_report_revision","run_id",run.ID)!=0{t.Fatal("revoked render or write")}
		var answersAfter int64;must(db.Model(&model.ManagementTraitsPaperQuestionSnapshot{}).Where("paper_id = ? AND raw_answer IS NOT NULL",o.paper.PaperID).Count(&answersAfter).Error,"revoked after");if answersBefore!=answersAfter{t.Fatal("revoked answers changed")}
		must(db.Model(&model.ManagementTraitsDefinitionBundle{}).Where("id = ?",o.profile.BundleID).Update("status","candidate-current-source").Error,"restore owned bundle");t.Log("CASE=revoked PASS=1 ANSWER_DELTA=0 RENDER_CALLS=0 REVISION_DELTA=0")
		}

		w:=create("00202","candidate");fill(w,140,3);window(w,8*time.Second)

		first:=child("pending");var firstLog bytes.Buffer;first.Stdout=&firstLog;first.Stderr=&firstLog;must(first.Start(),"first worker process");defer func(){if first.ProcessState==nil{_ = first.Process.Kill();_ = first.Wait()}}()

		var pendingExpiry int64;must(db.Raw("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM el_mng_paper_snapshot s INNER JOIN el_paper p ON p.id=s.paper_id WHERE s.source=? 		must(svc2.ScanExpiry(ctx,100),"repeat worker scan")

	}
	var pdfRows []map[string]any
	for i,tc:=range []struct{code,kind string;mode int}{{"00201","candidate",3},{"00201","tester",1},{"00202","candidate",5},{"00202","tester",0}} {

	t.Log("RESTORED_RESUME_300S_BINDING_END_EXISTING_RETIRED_REVOKED_PASS; UI_NOT_TESTED")
	w:=create("00202","candidate");expire(w)
	workerCtx,stop:=context.WithCancel(ctx);var workerErr error;workerDone:=make(chan struct{})
	go func(){defer close(workerDone);svc.RunExpiry(workerCtx,time.Hour,100,func(e error){workerErr=e});}()
	// Finite observation only; no sleep or unbounded polling.
	deadlineCtx,done:=context.WithTimeout(ctx,15*time.Second);defer done()
	var found model.ManagementTraitsResultRun
	for attempts:=0;attempts<100 && deadlineCtx.Err()==nil;attempts++ { if db.WithContext(deadlineCtx).Where("paper_id = ?",w.paper.PaperID).Take(&found).Error==nil {break} }
	stop();<-workerDone;if found.ID==""||workerErr!=nil{t.Fatal("restored worker immediate scan not observed")}
	assertRun(w,service.ManagementTraitsRuntimeSubmission{RunID:found.ID,Answered:0,Complete:false},0,false)
	t.Log("RESTORED_OFFLINE_WORKER_STARTUP_PASS; ACTUAL_SYSTEMD_SECOND_RESTART_SKIPPED_NO_HTTP_SESSION")
